subject: Middlesex Fells Trail Rehabilitation
overview: The Conservation Commission approved three Certificates of Compliance for Department of Conservation and Recreation projects and voted to issue an Order of Conditions for trail and footbridge rehabilitation in the Middlesex Fells Reservation.

items.title: Certificate of Compliance: Veterans Memorial Dugout Replacement (DEP #215-0234)
items.summary: Approved a full Certificate of Compliance for dugout replacement and ADA accessibility modifications at the Carmine Santoro Memorial baseball diamond in Veterans Memorial Park.

items.title: Certificate of Compliance: Flynn Rink Parking Lot Drainage and Paving (DEP #215-0237)
items.summary: Approved a full Certificate of Compliance for completed drainage repairs and stormwater infiltration work at the Flynn Rink parking lot.

items.title: Certificate of Compliance: Middlesex Fells Stream Crossing (DEP #215-0195)
items.summary: Approved a full Certificate of Compliance closing out previously completed 2014 stream crossing work over Straight Gully Brook in the Middlesex Fells Reservation.

items.title: Notice of Intent: Middlesex Fells Trail Rehabilitation and Bridge Replacement
items.summary: Approved an Order of Conditions with special conditions regarding contour restoration and off-trail staging for Friends of the Middlesex Fells' proposed bridge replacement and erosion remediation along the Cross Fells and Skyline trails, pending receipt of a DEP file number.

items.title: Meeting Minutes and Next Meeting Scheduling
items.summary: Tabled consideration of prior meeting minutes due to a lack of eligible voting members present and discussed scheduling an upcoming meeting to review local wetlands regulations.
